(120 UNITS)

The Bachelor of Arts in Communications (Link) provides students with training in the theory and practice of informing, instructing and persuading through communications media. Because effective ethical communications are essential for the well-being of a democratic society, the curriculum ensures that all majors are: exposed to a broad liberal education; provided with a clear understanding and a global perspective of the role of communications media in society; and prepared for communications-related careers in the mass media, business, government and education by educating them in depth on one of the specialized concentrations within the department.

The program includes 24 units of core requirements and 21 units in a chosen concentration. Students must also complete a minimum of 12 units, earned through: a Department of Communications certificate; a minor outside the department; or approved coursework outside the department. All Department of Communications prerequisite courses must be completed with a “C” (2.0) or better. Students must earn a minimum of 72 units outside the Department of Communications.

Concentration

The Public Relations concentration (Link) provides students with the skills to plan, develop, implement and evaluate strategic communications between organizations and people. They learn to execute campaigns through ethical practices that engage diverse stakeholders in such positions as account executive, public relations director, event planner, influencer coordinator, media relations, publicist and social media specialist.

A total of 21 units within the concentration are required, which include a required course (3), a principles course (3), elective courses (9 units), an upper-division writing course (3 units), and a capstone course (3). IMPORTANT: The Accrediting Council on Education in Journalism and Mass Communications has set forth strict guidelines for majors in communications. It is imperative that you see the CSU Fullerton catalog under \"Department of Communications,\" \"Bachelor of Arts in Communications\" for additional requirements (Link).

The Bachelor of Arts in Communications requires a minimum of 120 units. The Communications major totals 45 units: 24 units of core requirements; and 21 units in a chosen concentration. In addition, students must complete a minimum of 12 units, earned through a Department of Communications certificate, a minor outside the department or approved coursework outside the department. All Department of Communications prerequisite courses must be completed with a “C” (2.0) or better. Students must earn a minimum of 72 units outside the Department of Communications, plus must meet University General Education requirements. IMPORTANT: The Accrediting Council on Education in Journalism and Mass Communications has set forth strict guidelines for majors in communications. It is imperative that you see the CSU Fullerton catalog under \"Department of Communications,\" \"Bachelor of Arts in Communications\" for additional requirements.
